title: Parallel Trends Failure Pilot Fixture
abstract: This fixture contains otherwise standard DID reporting but includes clear pre-treatment trend divergence.

sections.parallel trends: The event-study shows different pre-treatment trends, statistically significant pre-period coefficients, and non-zero pre-period coefficients. The treated and control series are not parallel before treatment.
sections.no anticipation: No anticipation is supported by the timeline of announcement and implementation; event-study leads immediately before treatment are null.
sections.treatment timing: Staggered adoption is handled with Callaway-Sant'Anna and Sun-Abraham robustness for heterogeneous effects.
sections.sutva: SUTVA and interference are assessed with spillover robustness and buffer-zone checks.
sections.control group: A balance table shows matched controls; the donor pool is justified with matching checks.
sections.specification: The specification robustness table varies fixed effects, controls, and functional form choices.
sections.inference: Standard errors are clustered by province, with wild-cluster bootstrap robustness.
sections.sample period: Sample period and time-window sensitivity checks vary start period and end period.
sections.concurrent policies: Concurrent policies are enumerated and policy controls are reported.
sections.robustness placebo: Placebo and falsification tests are reported.
sections.data measurement: The data source documents definition stability and missingness handling.

figures.caption: Event-study plot with significant pre-period leads.
